university.name: Newcastle University
university.summary: A research-intensive university based in the centre of Newcastle upon Tyne, offering undergraduate, postgraduate taught and research degrees to students from more than 120 countries, with pathway courses delivered with INTO Newcastle University for international applicants.

courses.title: Computer Science
courses.overview: A three-year on-campus honours degree covering programming, computer systems, algorithms, data science and software engineering, finishing with a major project and dissertation in the final stage.
highlights: Major Project and Dissertation in Computer Science
courses.academic_requirements: A-level AAB or International Baccalaureate 34 points (2026 entry, as published on the course page). The page does not list requirements for qualifications from outside the UK.
courses.english_requirements: The course page gives no figure. The university's typical undergraduate requirement is IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 5.5 in each skill, PTE Academic 70, or Duolingo 125 overall with no skill below 100. The university states that individual course pages may list higher requirements.
courses.notes: Target year fee not yet published: the page shows the 2026/27 international fee and 2026 entry requirements. English figures are the university-wide typical undergraduate figures from the international English language page, not a course-specific figure.

courses.title: Law
courses.duration_text: 3 years full time (4 years with a placement or study abroad year)
courses.overview: A three-year qualifying law degree taught on campus, beginning with core areas of English law and legal method and allowing a placement or study abroad year as a fourth year.
courses.academic_requirements: A-level AAA or International Baccalaureate 36 points. The course summary does not list requirements for qualifications from outside the UK.
courses.english_requirements: The course summary gives no figure. The university's typical undergraduate requirement is IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 5.5 in each skill, PTE Academic 70, or Duolingo 125 overall with no skill below 100. The university states that individual course pages may list higher requirements.
courses.notes: The course summary is for a September 2027 start and gives the full time international fee under Tuition fees (Year 1) without printing an academic year label, so 2027/28 is inferred from the intake. The web page for this course (opened) still showed 2024 entry data and was not used. English figures are university-wide typical figures.

scholarships.name: Vice-Chancellor's International Scholarship (Undergraduate)
scholarships.value_text: GBP 7,000 credited to the tuition fee account, renewable annually for the length of the course subject to progression
scholarships.summary: An automatic tuition award for international undergraduates domiciled in a listed country, which includes Pakistan, who hold an offer for an eligible full time degree at the Newcastle city centre campus and who choose Newcastle as their UCAS firm choice.
scholarships.criteria_text: Applied through UCAS; assessed as international for fees; predominantly resident in a listed country for the last three years; not fully sponsored; Newcastle as firm choice. MB BS, BDS and Dental Therapy BSc, INTO pathway students and Clearing applicants are excluded.
scholarships.deadline_note: No fixed closing date; awards are allocated throughout the year before the degree starts.
scholarships.notes: Terms are the 2026/27 regulations; 2027/28 terms not yet published. Pakistan is named in the regulations country list.

scholarships.name: Vice-Chancellor's Excellence Scholarships (Postgraduate Taught)
scholarships.value_text: Up to 50% tuition fee discount, credited to the tuition fee account
scholarships.summary: A competitive discount of up to half of tuition fees for international applicants holding an offer for an eligible full time master's or MRes course at the Newcastle city centre campus, selected on academic ability and quality of application.
scholarships.criteria_text: Assessed as international for fees; offer for an eligible full time master's or MRes; equivalent of a UK upper second class honours degree or above; one application only; January starters not eligible.
scholarships.deadline_note: 2026/27 round closed on 2026-02-26 and 2026-05-26; 2027/28 dates not yet published.
scholarships.notes: Terms are the 2026/27 regulations; 2027/28 terms not yet published. Number of awards not stated.

scholarships.name: International early payment discount
scholarships.value_text: 2% off annual tuition fees when paid in full by the stated date
scholarships.summary: International fee-paying students who pay the annual tuition fee in full by the published date may deduct 2% from their payment. Students paying through a tuition fee loan are not eligible.
scholarships.criteria_text: International fee-paying students paying annual fees in full on or before the published date; applies only to the portion paid personally.
scholarships.deadline_note: For 2026/27 payment was due on or before 25 September 2026; the 2027/28 date is not yet published.
scholarships.notes: Only the 2026/27 date is published on the page; assumes the discount continues for 2027/28, which the page does not confirm.
